To: Sarah Mullins <sarah@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: integration gate — SDK auth + streaming smoke test

Hi Sarah / AtlasPay team,

Quick MAP checkpoint from our side ahead of the smoke test gate: we want to run a consolidated smoke test that covers SDK auth flows (token exchange + scope), streaming session stability (1k TPS simulation light), and a tool-calling example (payment-metadata enrichment). Proposed windows: Fri 30 Apr, 10:00–11:30 PT.

Open items we want resolved before the gate:
- Staging API key + token exchange endpoint (owner: AtlasPay)
- SDK integration: small UX change to emit keepalive at 25s (owner: Lauren)
- Streaming: baseline telemetry hooks and a 1-minute reconnect test (owner: Grace)
- Tool calling: sample payload and schema (owner: Monica)

Can you confirm the slot and whether staging keys will be shared or whether we should use temporary proxy tokens? I attached a short runbook draft and the evaluation checklist — we'll update after your confirmation.

Attachments: streaming-smoke-test-runbook.md (MD, 8KB), MAP_Eval_Checklist_v2.xlsx (Excel, 92KB)

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: integration gate — SDK auth + streaming smoke test

Markus — quick note from SDK side.

We can add the keepalive at 25s; estimate is 1 dev-day and a 2-hour verification run. I'll own the change and can push a branch by Thu EOD.

A couple of clarifying questions for AtlasPay:
- For token exchange, do you expect our client to call /oauth/token with client_assertion, or will you provide short-lived staging tokens?
- For tool calling, can you confirm schema v1 vs v2 (we saw both in the docs). If it's v2 we need one small mapping change (Monica + I can handle).

Sarah — tagging you on the questions above so we can lock scope before the smoke test.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop

Thanks for the rundown. Friday 30 Apr 10:00 PT works for us — I've put a tentative Zoom on the calendar (link below).

Answers:
- We'll provide short-lived staging tokens via our staging /token endpoint. We'll send a pdf with the exact curl examples.
- Tool calling: please use schema v2 (we rolled forward last month). We'll attach the updated schema and a short runbook excerpt.

Attachments: MAP_Eval_Checklist_v2.xlsx (Excel, 92KB), staging-credentials.pdf (PDF, 14KB), AtlasToolSchema_v2.json (JSON, 6KB)

Perfect — slot confirmed for Fri 30 Apr 10:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210

Summarizing owners & pre-gate deliverables (due Thu EOD unless noted):
- AtlasPay: share staging token endpoint + example curl; staging-credentials.pdf received (owner: Sarah) — DONE
- SDK keepalive patch (25s), branch and PR for devops to verify (owner: Lauren) — target Thu EOD
- Streaming telemetry + reconnect test (Grace) — add simple metrics export and a 1-min reconnect smoke (target Thu EOD)
- Tool-calling sample payload and mapping to schema v2 (Monica) — produce sample JSON and post to Drive (target Thu EOD)
- Test runner: Rachel to coordinate integration test job that runs quick smoke (owner: Rachel)

Plan for Friday: 10:00–10:10 quick sync to confirm environment, 10:10–11:10 run smoke tests, 11:10–11:30 triage and next steps. If we see a blocker, we'll execute fallback: rolling to a lighter streaming profile and a follow-up test next week.

Forwarded earlier attachments for convenience.

Thanks everyone — let's keep updates brief in this thread and use the Drive link for artifacts.

-Markus
